title: Qwen Code (default)
description: Qwen Code on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its model is reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: Qwen Code (Standard)
de.description: Qwen Code an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur sein Modell ist erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: Qwen OAuth (your login: sandbox-ai login qwen once) or DashScope with a key (--api-key dashscope.aliyuncs.com=DASHSCOPE_API_KEY); its hosts are open by default. A server of yours instead: the preset qwen-local-llm.
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-qwen or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on.
Its image first: sandbox-ai build qwen (a start builds it when it is missing).
